name: Arduino Nano Every (ABX00028)
record_note: The ATmega4809 is specified to run up to 20 MHz. The ATSAMD11D14A is the USB bridge and controls UPDI programming; PB04, PB05, and PA14 are occupied by these connections. The board documentation does not identify a single external main-clock source, so clock_sources stays empty. Build/flash profiles remain open.

onboard_devices.name: ATSAMD11D14A
onboard_devices.function: USB-to-UART bridge and ATmega4809 UPDI programming controller
onboard_devices.notes: PB04/PB05 carry the bridge UART and PA14 carries the UPDI connection. The board datasheet notes level shifters between the 3.3 V bridge and 5 V AVR.
